description: Defines constants, helper functions, and a base class for PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) entities used in radio communication, specifically for transmission and reception (TX/RX). It includes header size calculations, window size definitions, and a class managing common header and sequence number helpers.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_tx_rx_base
classes.description: Base class for PDCP transmission and reception entities, managing common header size, window size, and sequence number helpers.

methods.name: pdcp_data_pdu_header_size
methods.description: Returns the header size based on the sequence number size (12 or 18 bits).

methods.name: pdcp_window_size
methods.description: Returns the window size based on the sequence number size (12 or 18 bits).
